_doc: Presentation tunables only (no rule numbers). Sizes are canvas units, about 1 dp on phones and tablets (scripts/platform/display_scale.gd). auction_quick_bid_steps: raise amounts shown as buttons in the auction panel; the minimum legal bid always comes from rules.json. board_max_share_*: largest share of the screen's long side the board may take, so the controls keep room. trade_cash_steps: +/- buttons beside the trade cash fields. bot_step_seconds: pause between bot actions so people can follow.
